922.name: The Pit of Minos

up.description: To the up lies The Beach Head.

922.description:
You are in a low, lightless hollow beneath the pit, where the air is
stale and dry and the floor is gritty underfoot. Rough stone presses
close on every side, and a crooked shaft in the roof lets a thread of
daylight and river air trickle down. Gold dust and tarnished flecks of
metal glint faintly wherever your eyes can pick them out. A narrow climb
leads up and out toward the beach.

923.name: The Pit of Minos

down.description: To the down lies The Beach Head.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

923.description:
A worn stair of rough stone cuts down out of the pit toward the river-
smelling air of the beach, its steps hollowed by years of hooves. Heat
gathers in the sunken bowl and hangs there, thick with dust and the rank
smell of beast. The pit wall rises sheer on every hand, scored with long
scratches at the height of a horn. The floor of packed sand runs on east
into the arena.

926.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

926.description:
Pale sand drifts over the floor here, and everywhere in it lie bones:
ribs, jawbones and the long shins of cattle and worse, trampled half to
powder. The curving wall of the pit is stained brown to well above your
head. A dry, coppery stink rises from the sand whenever your boots stir
it. The passage runs on east and back west toward the stair.

928.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

928.description:
A great timber rack leans against the stone here, bristling with notched
swords, bent spears and axes with splintered hafts. Many of the weapons
are far too large for any man to swing, and all of them are streaked
with rust or something darker. Shards of broken blades crunch in the
dust underfoot. The passage continues east, and the way west leads back
toward the stair.

929.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

929.description:
In this cramped corner of the pit someone has made a kind of camp, with
a stone ledge scraped smooth and a sleeping hollow scratched deep into
the packed earth beneath it. A faded battle-standard hangs from a spike
driven into the wall, stiff with dust and cut to ribbons at its edge.
Tiny claw marks furrow the floor around the hollow in neat, soldierly
rows. Passages lead off east and west from this corner.

930.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

930.description:
The air here is sour with old sweat, and a pair of enormous stone
weights lie on the sand beside an iron bar bent into a shallow bow.
Grapefruit rinds, dried hard and brown, are scattered across the floor,
and a few are heaped against the wall as though someone eats here
between bouts of heavy lifting. Scuffed rings in the dust mark where
wrestlers have circled one another. The passage leads east and west.

931.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

931.description:
The ceiling drops low here, and the walls close in until a broad-
shouldered visitor must turn aside to pass. Torch brackets of black iron
hold stubs of guttering tallow, and the smoke has painted the stone
above them with greasy soot. Hoofprints as wide as dinner plates are
baked into the hardened floor. The passage slips on east into deeper
gloom, while west lies the way back toward the arena.

932.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

932.description:
A deep, damp draught moves along this stretch of passage, and with it
comes the steady rush of the river through the stone, somewhere close
beyond the wall. Water seeps down the masonry in dark streaks and
gathers in a shallow, muddy trough along the floor. Strings of old horn
and knuckle-bone hang from a rafter, clicking softly against one
another. The passage runs on east and west.

933.name: The Pit of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The Pit of Minos.

north.description: To the north lies A Nameless Place.

933.description:
The passage ends in a wide, crumbling landing where the stone floor is
cracked and strewn with chunks of fallen masonry. Painted on the wall in
dull red, a huge bull's head glares out at those who come this far, its
eyes mere black holes. Heat and a heavy animal reek pour down from the
way north. The passage you came by runs back west.

934.name: A Nameless Place

up.description: To the up lies The Final Trial Of Minos.

south.description: To the south lies The Pit of Minos.

934.description:
Here, at the far end of the pit, a throne has been raised on a dais of
rough slabs, built entirely of horns lashed and wedged together into a
monstrous seat. Heaped skulls form a low rampart at its foot, and every
surface is slick with grease and dust. A steep stair climbs up into the
dark, toward a chamber of cold stone above. The only other way out is
south, back down the passage.

extra_descs.throne horns dais:
The throne is a tangle of horns, hundreds of them, from goats and oxen
and some far larger, bound with greasy cord and wedged tightly together.
The seat is worn smooth and dark by long use.

900.name: homba
900.description: Part kestrel, part bear, part wolf.  Parts is parts, and makes an ugly whole.

901.name: swordsman
901.long_desc: The greatest swordsman in the land is standing here with a sneer on his face.

902.name: mummy
902.long_desc: The Mummy of Rabscuttle wanders here, hands aloft, walking towards you.

903.name: lizard
903.description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to its underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

904.name: woundwort
904.long_desc: General Woundwort, the dark demon of Minos, awaits to maul you to shreds.
904.description: He looks vaguely like a rabbit, but sure doesn't act like one.

905.name: franz
905.long_desc: Franz, Minos' henchman, is here ready to pump you up.
905.description:
Franz is no girlie man.  He is very muscular and looks as if he could
squeeze your head like a grapefruit.

906.name: hanz
906.long_desc: Hanz is here flexing his muscles and squeezing grapefruits.
906.description:
Hanz is no girlie man.  He is very muscular and looks as if he could
lift a large dragon.

907.name: minos
907.long_desc: King Minos the Minotaur is ready and waiting to gore you to death.

908.name: turtle
908.long_desc: A large dragon turtle breaks the surface churning the water into huge waves.
908.description: The turtle's shell is the size of a small house and looks as hard as rock.

909.name: hag
909.long_desc: You notice the face of an ugly hag in the sea weeds.
909.description: The sea hag is terribly fightful and has razor sharp teeth.

910.name: merman
910.long_desc: There is a merman swimming here brandishing his trident at you!
910.description: The merman has a powerful tail fin instead of legs.

911.name: crab
911.long_desc: A crusty looking crab is crawling around here searching for food.
911.description: It looks like a crab... what more can be said?

900.name: key
900.room_desc: A heavy golden key lies here.

901.name: shield
901.room_desc: A dark minotaur shield has been left here.

903.name: gauntlets
903.room_desc: A pair of gauntlets made from troll skin lie on the ground.

904.name: ring
904.room_desc: A shining ring of platinum lies here.  It has a tiny inscription.

905.name: flail
905.room_desc: A flail has been carelessly left here.

906.name: coins
906.room_desc: A great, gleaming pile of treasure lies at your feet.

907.name: spear
907.room_desc: A heavy spear has been tossed on the ground here.

908.name: trident
908.room_desc: There is a warrior's trident here.

909.name: boots
909.room_desc: A pair of boots sit here in a puddle of water.
